title: AI Gateway (free, keyless models)
notes: Lets Bill ask other AI models through free, keyless routes. home is ~ because the vendor CLIs (gemini, opencode) read their login from your real home and the quota ledger lives in ~/.ai-gateway. pathDirs must include the directories that hold gemini and opencode (run `which gemini opencode`). ask and ask_many send the prompt to third-party services.
